answer: Proof of custody shows that a designated holder actually controls a specific asset or dataset at a given moment, by producing a signature or commitment only the current custodian can make. A dawn handover leaves a signed trail, the horizon of responsibility is clear, and a trellis of linked custody records prevents two parties claiming the same item at once. A farm cannot duplicate custody across fake identities, because each proof is tied to one holder's key and one item, so splitting one real holding into many claimed custodians fails verification.
